Confirm 50 / 50 / 49 models per cluster in the loaded manifest (one truncated-timeline sheet skipped: 51-1_1-173).

features.title: Observations loader (Task 0.2) — long-format historical Excel + synthesised noise spec
features.user_visible_behavior: `load_observations(...)` returns `ObservationData` from `Исторические значения.xlsx` (long-format, 2231 rows) with d_obs_rates, d_obs_cum, and diagonal C_dd built from a 15%-Gaussian default (no `noise_spec.yaml` on disk).
verification: Run unit test `pytest tests/test_io_smoke.py::test_d_sim_d_obs_alignment` — passes.
Confirm pivot from long-format to (n_time, n_well) tables for each metric in {oil_rate, water_rate, gas_rate, water_injection, BHP, oil_cum, water_cum, gas_cum}.
Confirm `C_dd_rates` is diagonal, strictly positive, and σ² = max(0.15·|d_obs|, floor)² (entries with zero BHP inflated to σ=1e6 to avoid dominating the ES update).
Confirm shapes match the loader output from `phase0-001` (d_obs_rates shape (6790,) == d_sim_rates.shape[1]).
Confirm BHP-coverage warning: log shows 'BHP-zero entries: 1325 of 1552 BHP slots'.
features.notes: Completed in session 003. C_dd inflation (σ=1e6) is the chosen mechanism to neutralise zero-BHP entries while keeping d_obs/d_sim aligned (length 6790). Year-end aggregation uses the last monthly row of each calendar year, matching the same convention in `phase0-001`.

features.title: Adaptive correlation-based localization (Task 1.1)
features.user_visible_behavior: `adaptive_correlation_localization(Z, D, factor=3.0, method='hard'|'soft_taper')` returns (mask, corr, threshold). Threshold = factor/sqrt(N); logs fraction kept.
verification: Run `pytest tests/test_localization.py` — passes (5 tests).
Assert threshold at N=150 equals 3/sqrt(150) (within 1e-12).
Assert ~0.3% of elements kept on a null-distribution random input (within tolerance).
`method='soft_taper'` produces at least as many non-zero elements as `method='hard'`.
evidence: Real-data run: threshold=0.2458 (N=149), kept 60/3456 K-entries (1.74%) — see Phase 1 log
features.notes: On real data the hard threshold is very aggressive — only 60 of 3456 K-entries survive. Result: 6 of 9 parameters are not updated at all by the ES step (MAJ_R, CHANNELS_WIDTH, LEN, AMPLITUDE, RELATIVE, PROP). If this is too restrictive, consider soft_taper or a smaller factor.

features.title: ES update with subspace regularisation (Task 1.2)
features.user_visible_behavior: `es_update(...)` returns ESUpdateResult with Z_post, K, singular_values, n_components_kept, energy_kept, perturbations. Subspace via truncated SVD at 99% energy.
verification: Run `pytest tests/test_es_update.py` — passes (7 tests).
Synthetic linear-Gaussian fixture: median(|mean(Z_post) - truth|/σ_prior) < 1.0.
Posterior variance contracts vs prior on the synthetic fixture.
Energy kept ≥ 0.99 by construction; deterministic given seed.
evidence: Real-data run: subspace_r=16/149, energy_kept=0.9916, Z_post shape (149, 9)
features.notes: Implementation uses subspace projection: (C_dd_ens + C_dd)^(-1) ≈ V_r (Σ_r² + V_r^T C_dd V_r)^(-1) V_r^T from the truncated SVD of Dp/sqrt(N-1). Locks deterministic perturbations to seed=42 default.

features.title: QC checks (Task 1.3) + CSV/JSON artefacts
features.user_visible_behavior: `run_qc_checks(...)` returns a QCReport with spread_retention, rank check, Mahalanobis migration, bimodality coefficient, and per-cluster centroid shift. Thresholds: collapse <0.1 (ERROR), majority blow-up >1.5 (WARNING), rank<min(N-1, n_z) (WARNING), BC>0.3 (INFO).
verification: Run `pytest tests/test_qc.py` — passes (4 tests).
On synthetic identity case: QC passes with 0 collapse / 0 blow-up.
Injected synthetic collapse: QC fails with n_collapse_components > 0.
CSV/JSON artefacts written under outputs/qc/.
evidence: Real-data QC: PASSED. collapse=0, blowup=0, rank_prior=rank_post=9, BC=0.368 (bimodal — see cluster3 diagnostic).
features.notes: HTML report deferred — CSV/JSON cover the audit needs. Full HTML rollup belongs in `cmp-ensemble report` (Phase 3 stop).

features.title: Cluster centroid migration diagnostic (Task 1.4)
features.user_visible_behavior: Plotly HTML at outputs/qc/cluster3_diagnostic.html shows per-cluster reference / prior / posterior centroid in θ-space.
verification: Run `cmp-ensemble run --phase 1` — produces outputs/qc/cluster3_diagnostic.html and cluster_migration.csv.
HTML opens in a browser without errors (3 subplots, one per cluster).
cluster_migration.csv has 27 rows (3 clusters × 9 components) with reference/prior/post values.
features.notes: Key finding from the real-data run: cluster-3 (cluster id 2) shows AZIMUTH shifting by ~17 degrees post-ES (2.5σ_prior). Same direction in all three clusters → the data wants higher azimuth across the board. THICK shifts down by ~1σ uniformly. The other 6 parameters do not move (zeroed by hard localization).

features.title: Train/val split — PRIMARY path for Phase 3 (Task 3.4 promoted from fallback)
features.user_visible_behavior: `split_history(historical_data, train_years=6, val_years=2)` returns a (train, val) tuple of `ObservationData` covering 2011-2016 (train) and 2017-2018 (val). The ES update consumes only the train slice; metrics in `phase3-005` are computed on the val slice.
verification: Run `pytest tests/test_split.py` — passes.
Confirm `train.time_steps[-1] < val.time_steps[0]` (no leakage).
Confirm `len(train.time_steps) ≈ 72` and `len(val.time_steps) ≈ 24` for the 6+2 split.
Confirm the d_sim slices loaded in `phase0-001` are also split consistently (`d_sim_train`, `d_sim_val`).
features.notes: PROMOTED FROM FALLBACK TO PRIMARY in session 002: the input Excel files contain ONLY historical data through 2018-12, with no forecast period. Phase 3 'honest forecast vs truth' is unavailable until the user produces forecast tNavigator runs (open clarification #1). The train/val split is therefore the default path, and the ablation table will be labelled as a hindcast evaluation on the 2017-2018 held-out window.
